ba966d23.yl: Yield: 1 Wellington (1.4 kg tenderloin) · 10 portions × ≈ 230 g
c: Season and sear the tenderloin all over 4–5 min; brush with mustard; chill.
Duxelles: blitz mushrooms and shallots fine; cook in butter with thyme until completely dry (15–20 min); cool.
On cling film, lay overlapping prosciutto; spread duxelles; roll the beef tightly inside; chill 30 min.
Wrap in puff pastry, seam underneath; trim ends; egg-wash; chill 20 min; egg-wash again; score.
Bake 210 °C 15 min, then 190 °C 20–25 min to core 50 °C (medium-rare).
Rest 15 min; slice 2.5 cm with a serrated knife; serve with red wine jus.
ba966d23.st: Assembled raw 0–4 °C 24 h. Baked: serve the same service.
ba966d23.al: 1 Gluten (puff pastry) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (butter, puff pastry) · 10 Mustard (dijon mustard)

c: Bring sugar, orange juice, water and cinnamon to the boil.
Add cranberries; simmer 10–12 min until most berries burst and the sauce thickens (it sets more on cooling).
Remove cinnamon; add zest; cool; serve at room temp. with turkey, ham or cheese.

e70966d9.yl: Yield: 1 turkey 6 kg → ≈ 3.6 kg carved meat (−40%) · 24 portions × 150 g + 60 g stuffing
c: Dry-brine the day before: rub 10 g salt per kg inside and out; refrigerate uncovered 12–24 h.
Bring to room temp. 1 h; push herb butter under the breast skin; put lemon and onion in the cavity.
Roast 200 °C 30 min, then 160 °C ≈ 2 h (≈ 20 min/kg); baste every 30 min; cover breast with foil if it browns too fast.
Done at breast core 72 °C and thigh 80 °C; rest 30–40 min under foil before carving (carry-over +3 °C).
Soak diced bread in milk; sweat onion in butter 6 min; cool.
Mix with mince, chopped chestnuts, eggs, herbs and seasoning.
Bake in a buttered GN 180 °C 40 min until golden; core ≥ 75 °C; slice to serve 60 g.
e70966d9.st: Carved meat 0–4 °C 3 days; reheat in stock, core ≥ 75 °C. Carving station: heat lamp ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h.

c: Stud onion with cloves; infuse in milk with bay and peppercorns 20 min just below the boil; strain.
Whisk in fresh white crumbs; simmer 5 min until thick; finish with butter, cream, nutmeg and salt.
d4b5b170.st: 0–4 °C 3 days; loosen with milk on reheating.

c: Trim and halve sprouts; blanch 3 min; refresh.
Brown butter to nutty; sauté sprouts cut side down 4 min; add broken chestnuts 2 min.
5e2553e3.st: Blanched sprouts 0–4 °C 48 h. Finish to order.

c: Sweat onion, celery and garlic; add chopped mushrooms; cook dry.
Mix with chopped chestnuts and walnuts, crumbs, cranberries, eggs and sage; season.
Press into a lined tin; cover; bake 180 °C 45 min; uncover 15 min; rest 10 min; slice.

554966bb.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 130 g fish · 180 g salad g
c: Score fillets every 3 mm to cut the fine bones; portion 150 g; season with salt and lemon 30 min.
Boil potatoes, carrot and celeriac in skins; peel; dice 1 cm; blanch peas.
Mix with diced gherkin and onion; dress with mayo and mustard; chill 2 h.
554966bb.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, breadcrumbs) · 3 Eggs (eggs, mayonnaise) · 4 Fish (carp fillet) · 9 Celery (celeriac) · 10 Mustard (dijon mustard)

c: Sweat sliced onion in butter until soft.
Cut potatoes in 5 mm batons; layer with onion and sprats; finish with potatoes.
Pour over cream, milk and sprat brine (40 ml); top with crumbs and butter flakes.
Bake 200 °C 50–60 min until golden and tender.
Twist chipolatas into cocktail size (40 pcs); stretch bacon thin; wrap each one.
Roast 200 °C 20 min; brush with honey-mustard; roast 5 min more (core 72 °C).

c2504aeb.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 170 g capon · 60 ml sauce g
c: Push herb butter under the skin; season; truss.
Roast 180 °C 1 h 40 min, basting every 20 min, to core thigh 75 °C.
Soak morels 30 min; rinse well; strain the liquor.
Sweat shallots and morels in butter; deglaze with wine; reduce by half.
Add stock and morel liquor; reduce by half; add cream; simmer to coating.
c2504aeb.al: 7 Milk (butter, cream 33%) · 9 Celery (chicken stock) · 14 Sulphites (white wine)

ca2884fa.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 150 g goose · 60 g stuffing · 40 ml jus g
c: Remove fat from cavity; prick skin all over; pour boiling water over the skin; dry overnight uncovered.
Season inside and out with salt, pepper and marjoram.
Roast 160 °C 3–3.5 h, pouring off fat every 30 min (keep it for potatoes); finish 220 °C 15 min. Core thigh 85 °C.
Rest 20 min; carve breast and legs.
Sweat onion in butter; add diced apples 3 min.
Mix with chopped prunes, cubed brioche, eggs and thyme; season.
Bake in a buttered tray 180 °C 35 min.
Roast goose neck and wings with vegetables 30 min; deglaze with wine.
Add stock; simmer 1 h; strain; skim; reduce to 500 ml; thicken lightly.
ca2884fa.st: Cooked goose 0–4 °C 3 days. Goose fat 0–4 °C 2 months.
ca2884fa.al: 1 Gluten (brioche) · 3 Eggs (brioche, eggs) · 7 Milk (butter, brioche) · 9 Celery (chicken stock) · 14 Sulphites (red wine)

c: Sweat onion in butter 10 min; add chopped sage; cool.
Mix with pork, crumbs, egg, zest, stock and seasoning; roll 35 g balls.

4556eb30.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 150 g meatballs · 60 ml gravy · 20 g lingonberry g
c: Soak crumbs in milk; add finely chopped sweated onion, meats, egg and spices; mix well.
Roll 22 g balls; fry in butter in batches or bake 200 °C 12 min (core 72 °C).
Deglaze the pan with stock; add cream and soy; simmer; thicken lightly.
Serve meatballs in gravy with lingonberry jam.
4556eb30.al: 1 Gluten (breadcrumbs, soy sauce) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter, cream 33%) · 9 Celery (beef stock)

b7e2e45b.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 140 g turkey · 50 g stuffing g
c: Mix with pork, chopped chestnuts, crumbs, chopped sage, zest and seasoning.
Butterfly breasts; flatten to 2 cm; lay thigh strips over; season.
Spread stuffing; roll tight; wrap in pancetta; tie.
Roast 170 °C 60–70 min to core 72 °C; baste with butter; rest 15 min; slice 2 cm.
Roast wings, neck and giblets (no liver) with vegetables 200 °C 40 min.
Cover with water; add herbs; simmer 2 h; strain.
Cook flour in the turkey roasting fat 2 min; deglaze with port; whisk in hot stock; simmer 10 min; season; strain.

4f97fcfc.yl: Yield: 500 g butter + 1 l sauce · Portion: 20 g + 50 ml
c: Beat butter until pale; add icing sugar; beat in brandy slowly; pipe rosettes; chill.
Slake corn flour with some milk; boil remaining milk, cream and sugar; whisk in; simmer 2 min.
Off the heat add butter and brandy.
Crush biscuits fine; mix with hazelnuts and cocoa.
Melt chocolate with butter; mix in condensed milk and rum; combine with the crumbs; chill 1 h.
Roll 22 g balls; coat in cocoa or chocolate vermicelli.
6221d3ed.al: 1 Gluten (plain tea biscuits) · 6 Soybeans (dark chocolate 54%) · 7 Milk (plain tea biscuits, condensed milk, butter) · 8 Nuts (hazelnuts)

c: Line a bowl with sponge fingers; soak with sherry; scatter half the raspberries.
Heat water and sugar; dissolve soaked gelatine; add remaining berries; pour over; set 3 h.
Make a thick custard (boil 1 min); cool covered; spread over the jelly.
Whip cream with icing sugar to soft peaks; top; finish with toasted nuts.
253a7992.al: 1 Gluten (sponge fingers) · 3 Eggs (sponge fingers, egg yolks) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, cream 35%) · 8 Nuts (hazelnuts) · 14 Sulphites (medium sherry)

4ad05f21.yl: Yield: 1 tower ≈ 80 choux, 20 guests · Portion: 4 choux ≈ 130 g
c: Boil water, milk, butter, salt and sugar; add flour; dry the panade 2 min.
Beat in eggs gradually to a dropping consistency.
Pipe 3 cm buns; bake 190 °C 20 min then 170 °C 10 min until dry inside.
Make crème pât. with milk, yolks, 200 g sugar, corn flour, vanilla; boil 1 min; add butter; chill; fill choux from the base.
Cook 550 g sugar with water to 165 °C amber; dip choux tops; build the cone on a nougatine base or oiled cone; spin sugar threads.
4ad05f21.st: Filled choux 0–4 °C 12 h. Assemble max 4 h before service; keep dry.
4ad05f21.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs, egg yolks) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter)

51192df1.yl: Yield: 1 cake 20 cm, 28 slices · Portion: 1 slice ≈ 110 g
c: Soak fruit in 100 g brandy overnight.
Cream butter, sugar and treacle; add eggs; fold in flour, almonds, spice and fruit.
Bake in a double-lined tin 140 °C 3.5–4 h (skewer clean); feed with 50 g brandy weekly for 3–4 weeks.
Brush cake with warm jam; cover with 5 mm marzipan; dry 2 days.
Beat whites, icing sugar and lemon to stiff peaks; spread and rough up in peaks.
51192df1.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs, egg whites) · 7 Milk (butter) · 8 Nuts (almond flour, marzipan) · 14 Sulphites (currants, candied fruit mix)

c: Beat butter with icing sugar 10 min until white and fluffy; add yolk, brandy, vanilla.
Mix in flour, baking powder and almonds to a soft dough.
Bake 170 °C 20–22 min until pale golden on the base (≈ 1500 g).
Spray warm biscuits with rose water; bury in sifted icing sugar; cool; dust again.
983fbdee.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (egg yolks) · 7 Milk (butter 82%) · 8 Nuts (almonds)

c: Infuse crushed saffron in warm milk with melted butter (37 °C).
Knead with flour, sugar, yeast, salt and quark 10 min; prove 1 h.
Divide 60 g; roll 25 cm ropes; coil both ends into an S; push in raisins; prove 40 min.
5aa4c8d7.st: Best on the day; freeze 1 month.
5aa4c8d7.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter, quark)

c: Whisk oils, juice, sugar, brandy and zest; dissolve soda in the juice first.
Mix in flour, semolina, baking powder and spices just until combined (overmixing makes them hard).
Shape 50 ovals × 35 g; press with a fork; bake 180 °C 22–25 min until deep golden (≈ 1550 g).
Boil sugar, water and aromatics 6–8 min (105 °C); remove aromatics.
Cool completely before pouring (cold syrup on hot cake, or hot on cold).
Dip cooled cookies in hot syrup 20–30 s each side.
Drain on a rack; sprinkle with walnuts and cinnamon.
Whisk eggs, sugar and honey 8 min to thick foam.
Fold in nuts, chopped peel, spice, flour and baking powder; rest 1 h.
Dome 35 g on each wafer; dry 2 h; bake 160 °C 18–20 min.
Melt together to 45 °C; dip tops; set on racks.
379ca4ad.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, wafer bases) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 6 Soybeans (dark chocolate 54%) · 7 Milk (butter) · 8 Nuts (almond flour, hazelnuts) · 14 Sulphites (candied orange peel)

c: Batch · Yield ≈ 1550 g raw → 2 × 750 g baked
Lievitino: 50 g flour, 5 g yeast, 30 g milk, 20 g egg; prove 1 h.
1st dough: lievitino + 250 g flour, 100 g egg, 60 g sugar, 10 g yeast, 50 g butter; prove 2 h; 2nd: rest of flour, eggs, yolks, sugar, honey, salt, aromatics, 50 g butter; prove 12 h at 18 °C.
Laminate with 150 g cold butter: 3 single folds, 20 min rest between.
Round; star moulds buttered; prove 6–8 h at 26 °C to the rim.
Bake 170 °C 40–45 min to 94 °C core; cool 1 h in mould; dust with vanilla icing sugar to serve.
aff51909.al: 1 Gluten (strong bread flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs, egg yolks) · 7 Milk (butter, milk 3%)

c: Starter refreshed 3 times at 4 h intervals (28 °C, triples each time).
Knead flour, water, starter and sugar to a smooth dough; yolks gradually; butter last; dough 26 °C.
Knead first dough with flour; add sugar and yolks gradually, then honey, salt, aromatics; butter in 3 additions (windowpane).
Fold in soaked, dried raisins and peel; rest 1 h; divide 1100 g; round (pirlatura) twice; into 1 kg paper moulds.
Prove 6–8 h at 28 °C until 2 cm below the rim; skin 20 min; cross-cut; knob of butter.
Bake 165–170 °C ≈ 50 min to 94 °C core; skewer and hang upside down 10–12 h.
96cd2e5a.al: 1 Gluten (strong bread flour, sourdough starter) · 3 Eggs (egg yolks) · 7 Milk (butter) · 14 Sulphites (candied orange peel, candied fruit mix)

be3e0240.yl: Yield: 1 panforte Ø 24 cm · 24 portions × 40 g
c: Toast nuts; chop peel; mix with flour, cocoa and spices.
Boil honey and sugar to 118 °C (soft ball); pour over dry mix; stir fast.
Press 2 cm into a ring lined with rice paper or baking paper; wet hands.
Bake 150 °C 30 min; cool; dust thickly with icing sugar + cinnamon.
be3e0240.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour 00) · 8 Nuts (almonds, hazelnuts) · 14 Sulphites (candied orange peel, candied fruit mix)

c: Warm honey, sugar and butter until dissolved; cool; beat in egg.
Mix in dry ingredients; rest 12 h.
Mix to a thin glaze; dip warm biscuits; dry on racks.
ac3a9035.st: Airtight 4 weeks; they soften with time.
ac3a9035.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (butter) · 8 Nuts (almond flour)

c: Cream butter and sugar; add milk; mix in dry ingredients; chill 2 h.
Roll 4 mm (or press into moulds); cut; place on lined trays.
1afa3ed1.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 7 Milk (butter, milk 3%) · 8 Nuts (almond flour)

c: Whisk whites with icing sugar and lemon to stiff, glossy meringue; set aside 4 tbsp for glazing.
Knead the rest with almonds and cinnamon to a firm dough; roll 8 mm between sheets dusted with icing sugar.
Spread with reserved meringue; cut stars; dry 2 h; bake 140 °C 8–10 min (glaze stays white).

94a33797.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 150 g cotechino + 200 g lentils = 350 g
c: Batch · raw 1.8 kg → cooked, sliced ≈ 1500 g
Raw: soak 4 h in cold water; prick skin; start in cold water, simmer 80–85 °C 2.5–3 h (no boil, or it bursts).
Pre-cooked (vacuum): keep in the bag, 90 °C water 20–30 min.
Slice 1.5 cm while hot; keep in a little cooking liquid.
Small lentils (Castelluccio type), no soaking; rinse.
Soffritto in oil 10 min with garlic and sage; tomato paste 2 min.
Add lentils, bay and hot stock; simmer 30–35 min until tender and saucy; salt at the end.
Lentils 200 g in a warm deep plate; 3 slices cotechino (150 g) on top; raw olive oil. Optional: mostarda or mashed potato.
94a33797.st: Lentils: 0–4 °C, 72 h. Cotechino cooked: 0–4 °C, 48 h; reheat in its liquid to 75 °C core.
94a33797.al: 9 Celery (vegetable stock, celery). Cotechino: check label (may contain milk, sulphites).

be845991.yl: Yield: 1 galette Ø 26 cm = 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 110 g
c: Cream butter and sugar; beat in almond flour, then eggs one by one; add starch and rum.
Boil milk with split vanilla; whisk yolks, sugar and starch; temper with milk.
Return to the pan; boil 1–2 min whisking; off heat add butter.
Spread on a tray, cover with film in contact; chill fast to 4 °C.
Mix almond cream with crème pât. 2:1 (frangipane); place the fève if used.
Roll 2 puff discs Ø 28 cm, 3 mm; spread frangipane on one leaving 2 cm; egg-wash the border; cover; seal; trim to Ø 26 cm.
Egg-wash twice; score a pattern; pierce 5 vents; chill 1 h.
Bake 200 °C 10 min, then 180 °C 30 min; brush with hot syrup (sugar + water) for shine.
be845991.st: Ambient, 24 h; 0–4 °C, 3 days. Raw galette: −18 °C, 1 month.
be845991.al: 1 Gluten (puff pastry) · 3 Eggs (eggs, egg yolks) · 7 Milk (butter, milk 3%, puff pastry) · 8 Nuts (almond flour). Vegetarian. Fève: warn guests.

c: Simmer hock in water 1.5 h; remove; shred the meat.
Add peas, diced vegetables, garlic, bay and cayenne; simmer 40 min.
Cook rice separately; fold in with the meat; season.
Strip stems; shred leaves; braise with garlic, oil and a splash of hock liquor 20 min; finish with vinegar.
Knead to a smooth firm dough; rest 30 min.
Roll to a log; cut 12 g pieces; roll 8 cm discs, thinner at the edge.
Chop cabbage fine; salt 15 min; squeeze dry.
Beat pork with ginger, soy, wine and water in one direction until sticky; add cabbage, spring onion, sesame oil.
Fill 14 g; pleat; boil 6–7 min (float + 3 min, core 75 °C) or pan-fry and steam.
Mix all; serve 25 ml per portion.
681fde53.st: Raw dumplings: freeze on trays 2 months, cook from frozen. Filling 0–4 °C 24 h.
681fde53.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, soy sauce, shaoxing wine, chinkiang black vinegar) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce) · 11 Sesame (sesame oil) · 14 Sulphites (shaoxing wine)

c: Mix warm milk, yeast, flour, sugar, salt and egg to a smooth thick batter.
Fold in raisins, diced apple and zest; prove covered 1 h until doubled.
Scoop 45 g balls with an oiled ice-cream scoop into oil at 180 °C; fry 5–6 min, turning, until deep golden.
Drain; dust heavily with icing sugar; serve warm.
Heat dashi; season with soy, mirin and salt; keep below the boil.
Poach diced chicken, sliced carrot, daikon and shiitake in the broth 8 min (core 75 °C).
Grill mochi 200 °C 8 min until puffed; place 1 piece per bowl; ladle broth and fillings; add spinach and zest.
a89e1ee2.st: Broth with chicken 0–4 °C 3 days. Grill mochi to order.
a89e1ee2.al: 1 Gluten (usukuchi soy sauce) · 4 Fish (dashi) · 6 Soybeans (usukuchi soy sauce)

393adeff.yl: Yield: 2 rings, 20 slices · Portion: 1 slice ≈ 110 g
c: Knead all except butter 10 min; add butter; knead until elastic; prove 2 h (or overnight cold).
Brush with egg; decorate with candied fruit, almonds and wetted pearl sugar.
Bake 180 °C 20 min; cool; split; fill with sweetened whipped cream.
393adeff.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter, cream 35%) · 8 Nuts (almonds) · 14 Sulphites (candied fruit mix)

c: Boil potatoes, carrots and beetroot in skins; cool; peel; grate coarse separately. Hard-boil eggs 10 min; grate.
Layer in a ring or tray: diced herring with onion, potato, thin mayo, carrot, mayo, egg, mayo, beetroot, mayo.
Chill 6 h to set; cut portions; garnish with dill.
Bring dashi to a simmer; add soy, mirin and sugar; simmer 2 min; keep hot.
Cook soba 4–5 min; rinse in cold water to remove starch; re-warm in hot water to order.
Bowl: 220 g soba, 300 ml broth, kamaboko slices, 1 egg halved, spring onion; offer shichimi.
1371ea55.st: Broth 0–4 °C 4 days. Cook noodles to order.
1371ea55.al: 1 Gluten (usukuchi soy sauce, soy sauce, soba noodles) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 4 Fish (dashi, kamaboko) · 6 Soybeans (usukuchi soy sauce, soy sauce)

ecc00c75.yl: Yield: 20 pieces (30 × 40 tray) · Portion: 1 piece ≈ 105 g
c: Cream butter and sugar 6 min until pale; add eggs one by one.
Fold in flour, baking powder and mahlepi alternately with milk and juice; add zest and vanilla.
Spread in a lined tray; insert a foil-wrapped coin (optional; inform guests); top with almonds.
Bake 170 °C 45–50 min until a skewer comes out clean (2370 → ≈ 2100 g).
Cool; dust with icing sugar; stencil the year on top.
ecc00c75.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (butter, milk 3%) · 8 Nuts (almonds)

c: Julienne vegetables fine; keep in separate iced piles; drain well.
Cut wonton wrappers in strips; fry 175 °C until crisp.
Slice salmon thin (fish frozen −20 °C 24 h for parasites); dress with lime just before serving.
Mix plum sauce, sesame oil and lime.
Arrange piles on a platter with salmon; at the table add dressing, crushed peanuts, sesame and five-spice; toss high together.
13d204c8.st: Vegetables 0–4 °C 12 h. Salmon 0–2 °C, slice to order.
13d204c8.al: 1 Gluten (wonton wrappers) · 3 Eggs (wonton wrappers) · 4 Fish (salmon fillet) · 5 Peanuts (peanuts) · 11 Sesame (sesame oil, sesame seeds)

34bf8862.yl: Yield: 2 doves ≈ 1 kg, 24 slices · Portion: 1 slice ≈ 90 g
c: Mix flour, water, yeast and sugar; add yolks, then butter; knead smooth.
Add flour, sugar, yolks and honey to the first dough; knead; add butter, zest, vanilla and salt; then the peel.
Rest 1 h; shape into dove moulds (wings + body); prove 5–6 h at 28 °C.
Whisk whites, sugar and ground almonds; spread on top; scatter almonds and pearl sugar.
Bake 170 °C 40–45 min (core 94 °C); hang upside down to cool.
34bf8862.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (egg yolks, egg whites) · 7 Milk (butter) · 8 Nuts (almond flour, almonds) · 14 Sulphites (candied orange peel)

41395ce4.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 68 g (2 halves) · Portion: 68 g
c: Lower the eggs into boiling water; cook for 10–11 min.
Cool immediately in iced water for 10 min; peel. (520 g = net shelled weight.)
Halve lengthwise; remove the yolks and pass them through a fine sieve.
Mix the yolks with the mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar, salt and pepper until smooth.
Pipe into the whites with a star nozzle.
Chill at 0–4 °C for at least 30 min before service.
Dust with the paprika and chives. Serve 2 halves (68 g) per portion at 4–8 °C; max 2 h out of refrigeration.
41395ce4.al: 3 Eggs · 10 Mustard · 14 Sulphites (vinegar, Dijon mustard) · Mayonnaise: check label

c: Knead flour, warm milk, yeast, sugar, butter, egg, salt and spice 10 min; add fruit and zest; prove 1 h.
Divide 80 g; shape tight; prove 45 min.
Bake 200 °C 15–18 min; brush with hot sieved jam.
9125b5e5.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter) · 14 Sulphites (candied orange peel)

c: Cream butter and sugar 5 min; add eggs, milk, zest and vanilla.
Work in flour and baking powder to a soft, non-sticky dough; rest 15 min.
Roll 30 g pieces into 18 cm ropes; fold and twist into braids or coils.
Egg-wash; sprinkle sesame; bake 180 °C 15–18 min until golden (1568 → ≈ 1400 g).
2635c023.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (butter, milk 3%) · 11 Sesame (sesame seeds)

c: Wash offal; blanch 5 min; drain; dice 1 cm (keep 2500 g fresh water for the soup).
Whisk eggs to foam; whisk in starch, then lemon.
Temper with 4 ladles of hot cooking liquid, whisking constantly.
Stir back into the pot off the heat; shake pan gently over low heat until thickened (≤ 80 °C, never boil).
Sauté offal in butter and oil 5 min; add sliced spring onion and shredded romaine 5 min.
Add 2500 g water; simmer 40 min; add rice and dill; cook 15 min more.
Off the heat finish with avgolemono; serve at once.
e6473408.st: 0–4 °C, 48 h; reheat gently, do not boil.

c: Cut lamb 4 cm; sear in batches in oil; add onion and garlic; sprinkle sugar, caramelise lightly; singer with flour 2 min.
Add tomato paste and tomatoes, stock and herbs; braise covered 150 °C 1 h 15 min.
Add potatoes and turnips 25 min before the end; glaze carrots and pearl onions in butter; blanch peas and beans.
Skim fat; fold in all vegetables; season; finish with parsley.

4959c0d9.yl: Yield: 1.2 kg mould, 12 portions · Portion: 100 g
c: Hang quark in muslin 12 h; press through a sieve.
Whisk yolks, sugar and cream; cook to 82 °C stirring; cool to 40 °C.
Beat in butter and vanilla; fold in quark, raisins, candied fruit and almonds.
Pack into a lined, weighted mould over a bowl; drain 0–4 °C 24 h; unmould.
4959c0d9.al: 3 Eggs (egg yolks) · 7 Milk (quark, butter, cream 33%) · 8 Nuts (almonds) · 14 Sulphites (candied fruit mix)

40f238c4.yl: Yield: 1 pastiera Ø 28 cm · 16 slices × 150 g
c: Batch · Yield ≈ 850 g (1 tart Ø 26 cm base + lattice)
Rub cold butter into flour, sugar, zest, salt and baking powder to crumbs (or paddle 1 min).
Add eggs; bring together without kneading; flatten; wrap; chill ≥ 2 h.
Soak wheat 3 days (change water daily); simmer 1.5 h until soft (160 g → ≈ 400 g) or use 400 g ready grano cotto.
Cook wheat with milk, butter and zest 15 min to a creamy mass; cool.
Sieve ricotta with sugar (best rested overnight); add eggs, yolks, wheat cream, candied fruit, cinnamon, vanilla, orange blossom water.
Line the tin 4 mm; fill; 7 frolla strips in a lattice (traditional).
Bake 160 °C 70–80 min until amber; cool in the oven with door ajar.
Rest 24 h before cutting (flavours settle); icing sugar.
40f238c4.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour 00, wheat grains) · 3 Eggs (eggs, egg yolks) · 7 Milk (butter, ricotta, milk 3%) · 14 Sulphites (candied fruit mix)

aa15b52a.yl: Yield: 1 cake 20 cm, 16 slices · Portion: 1 slice ≈ 110 g
c: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs; fold in flour, spice, fruit and zest.
Spread half in a lined tin; lay a 250 g marzipan disc; top with remaining batter.
Brush with jam; cover with marzipan disc; roll 11 balls (the apostles without Judas).
Brush with egg; glaze under a hot grill or torch.
aa15b52a.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (butter) · 8 Nuts (marzipan) · 14 Sulphites (currants, candied orange peel)

c: Knead to a smooth elastic dough; divide into 6 balls; oil; rest 1 h.
Blanch chard; squeeze; chop; sauté with onion in oil; cool.
Mix with ricotta, 50 g egg, parmesan and marjoram; season.
Layer 3 paper-thin sheets (oiled) in the tin; add filling; make 8 hollows and crack an egg into each.
Cover with 3 sheets; seal; bake 180 °C 60 min.
267f3e69.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (ricotta, parmesan). Vegetarian.

c46599bb.yl: Yield: 3 braided loaves (20 slices) · Portion: 1 slice ≈ 90 g
c: Warm milk with butter and half the sugar to 35 °C; dissolve yeast.
Mix with flour, eggs, remaining sugar, zest, mahlepi, mastic (ground with sugar) and salt; knead 12 min until silky and stringy.
Divide into 9 × 225 g; roll 40 cm ropes; braid 3 loaves; prove 1 h 30 min until doubled.
Bake 170 °C 30–35 min until deep brown (core 94 °C); cover with foil if colouring fast.
c46599bb.al: 1 Gluten (strong bread flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (butter, milk 3%) · 8 Nuts (almonds)

c: Mix dry; whisk in milk, eggs and butter.
Bake 200 °C 20 min; cool; cut 2 cm cubes; dry overnight.
Brown sausage; add onion and celery 8 min; add sage.
Toss with cornbread, toasted pecans, stock and egg.
ee22ea98.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter) · 8 Nuts (pecans) · 9 Celery (celery, chicken stock)

c: Sauté mushrooms, shallot and garlic in butter; add flour; whisk in stock and cream; simmer 5 min.
Fold in beans and half the onions; bake 180 °C 20 min; top with remaining onions 5 min more.
a2001323.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, crispy fried onions) · 7 Milk (butter, cream 33%) · 9 Celery (chicken stock)

c: Layer lamb, onions, carrots and half the potatoes (diced) in a pot; add barley, herbs and water.
Simmer covered 1 h; add remaining potatoes in chunks; cook 45 min until the diced potatoes thicken the broth.

9b64b5fd.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 3 latkes 150 g · 30 g apple sauce · 20 g sour cream g
c: Grate potatoes and onion coarse; squeeze very dry; let the starch settle and add it back.
Mix with eggs, meal and seasoning.
Fry 50 g flat cakes in 1 cm oil at 180 °C 3 min per side until crisp; drain.
Cook apples with sugar, lemon and cinnamon 12 min; mash coarse; cool.
Serve latkes with apple sauce and sour cream.
9b64b5fd.st: Fry to order; hold crisp 170 °C max 30 min.
9b64b5fd.al: 1 Gluten (matzo meal or breadcrumbs) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (sour cream 20%)

db31247b.yl: Yield: 1 pie 24 cm, 10 slices · Portion: 1 slice ≈ 140 g + 20 g cream
c: Rub butter into flour, sugar and salt; bind with ice water; chill 1 h.
Line the tin; blind-bake 190 °C 15 min with weights, 5 min without.
Whisk purée, milk, eggs, sugar, spices and salt smooth; pour into the warm shell.
Bake 170 °C 45–50 min until set with a slight wobble; cool 2 h.
Serve with softly whipped sweetened cream.
db31247b.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (butter, evaporated milk, cream 35%)

c: Roast whole sweet potatoes 200 °C 50 min; scoop; mash with butter, sugar, eggs, milk, cinnamon and salt.
Rub flour, sugar and butter; add chopped pecans; scatter over half; marshmallows over the other half.
